_source: Captured 2026-10-31 on this unit via `aseqdump -p 16:0` (ALSA seq client 16 'M-Game RGB Dual Streaming Port'). Device sends nothing when idle.
_format: Per-button message: F0 00 01 05 42 00 01 <id> 01 02 01 <state> 00 00 00 <checksum> F7 ; state 01=press 00=release. Device ALSO sends a bitmask message per press: F0 00 01 05 42 00 01 00 00 02 00 00 <lo> <hi> 00 <cs> F7 (release = lo 00 hi 02) — ignore it, match the per-button one.
